data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for adapting screen and font size across different device models.
data.what_it_does: Adapts UI layouts and font sizes based on a provided design draft size. Offers extension methods to easily scale widths, heights, radii, and font sizes.
use_when: You need to precisely match UI dimensions from design drafts across varying screen sizes
You want a straightforward way to scale fonts and spacing using extension methods like .w, .h, and .sp
avoid_when: You prefer responsive layouts built using standard Flutter layout widgets and flexible constraints rather than fixed scaling
Your app utilizes completely fluid designs that do not rely on fixed design-draft dimensions
strengths: Supports split screen mode and minimum text adaptation
Allows enabling or disabling scaling programmatically
weaknesses: Relies on a fixed design draft size which may not suit all adaptive/responsive design paradigms
Can require careful configuration during widget tests (e.g. pumpAndSettle)
data.setup_notes: Initialize ScreenUtilInit once in your app's widget tree.
